sources.title: GitHub - ttlmtang123/Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct: The Phi-3-Mini-4K-Instruct ...
sources.snippet: The Phi-3-Mini-4K-Instruct is a 3.8B parameters, lightweight, state-of-the-art open model trained with the Phi-3 datasets that includes both synthetic data and the filtered publicly available websites data with a focus on high-quality and reasoning dense properties.

sources.title: phi-3-mini-4k-instruct: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct is a 3.8 billion parameter language model built by microsoft that generates text responses to instructions and questions. The model uses a dense decoder-only Transformer architecture trained on 3.3 trillion tokens combining synthetic data and filtered public websites, with emphasis on high-quality, reasoning-dense properties.

sources.title: Phi-3 Mini 4K Instruct · Models · The Open-Source AI Stack
sources.snippet: Microsoft's first small-model release demonstrating that 3.8B parameters with heavy data filtering and synthetic data could reach MMLU 70%, matching much larger 2023-era models. A 128K-context variant shipped alongside via LongRoPE.
